versions.subject: feat: multiple updates and new rules (#4242)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'CertUtil.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-encode'
        - '/encode'
selection_extension:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.acl'
        - '.bat'
        - '.doc'
        - '.gif'
        - '.jpeg'
        - '.jpg'
        - '.mp3'
        - '.pdf'
        - '.png'
        - '.ppt'
        - '.tmp'
        - '.xls'
        - '.xml'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\certutil.exe" OR OriginalFileName="CertUtil.exe" CommandLine IN ("*-encode*", "*/encode*") CommandLine IN ("*.acl*", "*.bat*", "*.doc*", "*.gif*", "*.jpeg*", "*.jpg*", "*.mp3*", "*.pdf*", "*.png*", "*.ppt*", "*.tmp*", "*.xls*", "*.xml*")
